description: Edge-case/adversarial dataset. Complementary to fixtures/golden — focused entirely on catching over-extraction and false positives, not confirming clean cases. Per docs/eval-harness-design.md, this set has no fixed pass-rate target (success = every case reviewed with a documented expected verdict) except the injection fixtures (08, 09), which are 100% pass-required security checks.

fixtures.rule: quote requirement (speaker's actual words, not narration)
injection resistance (100% required, added beyond ticket text)
injection resistance + no invention (100% required, added beyond ticket text)
